$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：廉貞獨坐寅申，《深造講義》p.172。

basis.quote: 须详其为敏感，抑为踏实

rules.text: 你的廉貞在申獨坐，不見煞忌而有吉化吉星：成雄宿乾元格，行到七殺的大限會發跡。
rules.en: Your Lian Zhen sits alone in Shen, free of malefics and Ji, with favourable transformations and stars: the 'heroic star' pattern, rising when you reach the Qi Sha stage.

source.quote: 行至七杀独坐的宫垣发迹

rules.text: 你敏感的廉貞帶藝術氣質，重精神生活。
rules.en: A sensitive Lian Zhen has an artistic temperament and values the inner life.

source.quote: 敏感的廉贞一般带艺术气质

rules.text: 踏實的廉貞，就算重視精神生活，也以物質享受為基礎。
rules.en: A grounded Lian Zhen, even valuing the inner life, builds it on material comfort.

source.quote: 亦必以物娇享受为基础

rules.text: 你的廉貞與火鈴同宮，敏感容易走向不好的一面，例如自作多情。
rules.en: Your Lian Zhen shares the palace with Huo or Ling, so sensitivity can take a bad turn, such as reading too much into things.
rules.edit: 原句續講投機取巧、趨炎附勢，屬人格貶語，不用。

source.quote: 而且亦使之具有不良的敏感本质

rules.text: 對面遷移宮的貪狼有祿存同宮，你一生多順遂，在困境中也往往突生意外之喜。
rules.en: Tan Lang opposite you shares its palace with Lu Cun: life goes smoothly for the most part, and even in difficulty, unexpected good fortune often appears.

source.quote: 且往往于困境中突生意外之喜

rules.text: 七殺所在的那一步運，是你的重要運限：見吉化吉星，就是開創的時候。
rules.en: The phase through Qi Sha is a key one for you: with helpful stars or transformations, it is your time to break new ground.

rules.text: 敏感的你，行到天同所在的運，只要煞忌不重，一般就是奠定基業的時候。
rules.en: Being the sensitive kind, the phase through Tian Tong, unless harsh stars crowd in, is usually when you lay your foundations.

source.quote: 一般为奠立基业的运限

rules.text: 踏實的你，行到貪狼化祿的運，財喜接連而來。
rules.en: Being the grounded kind, a phase with Tan Lang in Abundance brings one gain after another.
